title: Parts
description: A page whose body is a list of parts stored in its own page.jsonl.

add.text: Every block on this page is one line in its own `page.jsonl`. Add, move or remove a line and every open tab redraws, with no reload.

add.title: Three kinds so far
add.text: heading, text and card. A new kind is one small class.
